summary.const: Imported delegate (lambda) step is not supported

remediation.const: Workflow import file '{0}' declares a delegate (lambda) step at {1} (step '{2}'). A lambda step body is dropped on export (LB-1) and cannot be re-bound on import, so the workflow is rejected and no saga is generated. Replace it with a named IWorkflowStep<TState> step type.

description: AGWF027 — Imported delegate (lambda) step is not supported (DR-14).
